feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 September 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 07 September 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low to south of Iceland, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing southwest this morning, increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 early in the afternoon, then veering west or southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate occasionally rough this afternoon.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from west this afternoon, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, veering west or northwest 5 to 7 early tomorrow evening, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in places, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then scattered showers for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate showers.
